body:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: spike in 5xx from ingress -> api-gateway. 5m error rate 12% (baseline 0.3%). Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Alert: LB-5xx-High. Links: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/ingress ERR_RATE, runbook: https://wiki.redwood.local/incidents/lb-5xx

sara (oncall): acked. I'm jumping in now. Any known deploys?

jun: I see a deploy to ingress-configs ~20m ago that changed retry policy and route weighting for canary. Notified via deploy-bot: `deploy ingress-configs: rev f3a2`

matt: paged, will join. Can we get concrete impact numbers? Which customers / regions?

ewa: quick check: 5xx is concentrated in eu-central and us-west, primarily POST /v1/generate. Client error pattern: gateway-timeout + upstream-5xx. Sample logs:```
2026-03-15T14:22:01Z envoy [warning] upstream reset: 502 Bad Gateway
2026-03-15T14:22:02Z envoy [error] route weighted cluster overflow: 503
```

sara (oncall): looks like envoys are returning 5xx, maybe retries + circuit breakers interacting. Jun, can you pull the envoy route config diff?

jun: pasted relevant diff from git:```diff
- retry_policy: {}
+ retry_policy:
+   retry_on: 5xx,connect
+   num_retries: 5
+   per_try_timeout_ms: 2000
- circuit_breakers:
-   thresholds: []
+ circuit_breakers:
+   thresholds:
+     - priority: DEFAULT
+       max_connections: 100
+       max_pending_requests: 100
+       max_requests: 500
+       track_timeout: 20s
```

jun: That num_retries=5 combined with per_try_timeout may be amplifying load. Also I see max_connections lower than expected for the new route weight shift.

matt: that matches the symptom: retries causing upstream pressure -> upstream responds 5xx -> retries amplify -> cascade. We should disable retries at LB immediately. Sara, can you run a quick curl test against a single backend before/after?

sara (oncall): running test now against backend instance ip 10.12.4.8:```
$ curl -i -X POST https://10.12.4.8/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"test"}' -H 'Host: api-gateway' --max-time 6
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
...
```

sara (oncall): applying hotfix: remove retry policy on problematic routes and bump cb thresholds. Command:```
kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: ingress-envoy-overrides
data:
  envoy.yaml: |
    route:
      retry_policy: {}
    circuit_breakers:
      thresholds: []
EOF
```

incident-bot: Action taken: patch applied by sara (oncall) at 2026-03-15T14:29:10Z. Telemetry: 2m to propagate to edge fleet.

ewa: early metric bump down: 5xx rate from 12% -> 3.5% in 90s. Latency stable.

jun: good. Next steps: revert the canary weight change and schedule a controlled rollout with lower retries. I can back out the ingress-configs commit if needed.

matt: agree. Sara, hold on pager for now and coordinate with infra to confirm upstream healthy. I'll get infra-sre on a bridge.

customer-success: we have two paying customers experiencing errors in EU (IDs: C-421, C-802). Can we get ETA for user-facing fix? They asked for status.

sara (oncall): ETA 15-20m for full error rate back to <1%. Will update CS with interim note. No customer data lost; this is availability only.

matt: infra on bridge. Finding: origin pool for eu cluster had one node with health drain flapping; LB retried aggressively and overwhelmed the remaining nodes. Actions: 1) disable retries at edge (done), 2) increase cb thresholds to allow more in-flight, 3) cordon/flavor the flapping node for replacement.

jun: running the cordon & drain for bad instance:```
kubectl cordon node-eu-34
kubectl drain node-eu-34 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data```
Reprovision started.

ewa: post-mitigation metrics: 5xx -> 0.9% after 7m, tail latency down. Graph: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/ingress/now-15m

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Mitigation SUCCESS: error rate under threshold. Monitoring for 30m.

sara (oncall): handing off to matt for post-incident ops and to jun for config rollback and safe rollout. I'll remain on-call until 15:00 UTC to monitor.

matt: taking over. Assigning action items: jun to open rollback PR for ingress-configs, include test plan and reduced num_retries (<=2) and per_try_timeout 1s. Sara to write out immediate timeline for CS. Ewa to capture metric deltas for postmortem. I'll schedule followup postmortem.

jun: created PR #1874 to revert canary weight and remove aggressive retries. Tests: run k6 load test against staging route with retries 2 vs 5.

customer-success: sending update to customers now: brief summary + ETA for postmortem. Thanks team.

sara (oncall): quick note for postmortem: root cause = combined regression: (1) config change increasing retries (num_retries=5) and (2) route weight shift reducing upstream pool capacity + aggressive circuit breaker thresholds. Contributing factor: no e2e load guard for changes that affect retries.

matt: agreed. Postmortem to include: timeline, diffs, why canary didn't catch, mitigation steps, and a new gating rule in CI to prevent retry_on 5xx num_retries > 3 on critical routes.

ewa: logging snippet to include in postmortem:```
[14:25:12] envoy upstream reset: remote reset, num_retries used 5, upstream queue length 480
[14:25:13] envoy rate limit triggered: 503 over capacity
```

incident-bot: Incident thread will remain open for 2 hours for followup. Tags: lb, envoy, retries, circuit-breaker, paging.

matt: closing notes: no customer data impact, short downtime for some customers (~6-12 minutes of high errors), mitigated. Postmortem assigned. Thanks all. :clap:
